items.title: Delegate user access to AI agents with Amazon Cognito token exchange
items.summary: Suppose you use a restaurant review app to check reviews, book tables, and email invitations to your friends. With OAuth 2.0, the app sends you to the authorization server that your email provider trusts, where you sign in and approve only the access the app requested, such as the contacts.read and messages.send scopes.
